title: Learning to Assign Prediction Tasks to Agents with Capacity Constraints
abstract: arXiv:2605.27999v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We address the problem of learning to assign prediction tasks to one agent from a set of available agents, including human decision-makers and AI models. We focus on sequential learning of agent expertise and assignment policies where each agent is constrained to handle a fraction of tasks. We provide a general theoretical characterization of this problem in terms of agent capacities, differences in agent expertise, and task context. We then develop a framework of sequential explore-exploit policy-learning algorithms that seek to maximize overall performance. Experimental results over a variety of tabular, image, and text prediction tasks demonstrate systematic gains from our policy-learning algorithms relative to non-contextual baselines across different types of agents, including LLMs and humans.

translated_title: 学习在容量约束下向智能体分配预测任务
translated_abstract: 我们研究了如何从一组可用智能体（包括人类决策者和AI模型）中学习将预测任务分配给某个智能体的问题。我们专注于在智能体容量受限的条件下，顺序学习智能体的专长与任务分配策略。我们根据智能体容量、智能体专长差异以及任务情境，对该问题提供了一般性的理论刻画。随后，我们开发了一个旨在最大化整体性能的顺序探索-利用策略学习算法框架。在多种表格、图像和文本预测任务上的实验结果表明，我们的策略学习算法相较于非情境基线方法，在不同类型的智能体（包括大语言模型和人类）上都取得了系统性的性能提升。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种在容量约束下向人类与AI智能体分配预测任务的策略学习框架，通过顺序探索-利用算法在多种预测任务上实现了系统性性能提升。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a policy-learning framework for assigning prediction tasks to human and AI agents under capacity constraints, achieving systematic performance gains through sequential explore-exploit algorithms across diverse prediction tasks.
